subject: ddl: run add-index subtasks at system keyspace tidb (#62045)
summary: Reviewed `c56481e^1..c56481e` focusing on DDL/add-index disttask + cross-keyspace metadata behavior. The core change is selecting the per-task keyspace KV store + session pool when running subtasks under the system keyspace, and propagating the store’s keyspace into ingest backend config to avoid using the instance global keyspace implicitly. No Blocker/High issues found in correctness, data consistency, compatibility, concurrency, or metadata/state-machine handling. Later upstream history contains refactors (DXF renames/cross-KS detection tweaks) but no evidence of a high-severity bug fix specifically required for this change.
